title: Smith Project Manifest
description: Per-project manifest (smith.yml). Declares what a project is, never how it is built. Project names must be unique across the repository (enforced by smith during discovery, not expressible here).

version.description: File-format version. Always 1 for this schema.

name.description: Project name. Canonical dependency identifier; must be unique across the repo.

type.description: Project type ref(s) from the registry: language/flavor/kind@version. A single ref may be written as a bare string (sugar); several refs compose the project from multiple types, which then must declare disjoint targets, params, and environment keys (enforced by smith at load).

oneOf.description: Multiple type refs, composed in declaration order.

depends_on.description: Dependencies on other projects by name. Sugar form: a bare string means dep's 'build' before this project's 'build'. Explicit form: run 'targets' on the dependency before 'before' targets on this project. Both default to [build]. Referenced names and duplicate deps are validated by smith.

params.description: Values for params the project type declares. Keys not declared by the type are a hard error at execution time.

environment.description: Extra environment variables for this project's target steps. Values are Go templates over the merged params; overrides the type's environment.

dotenv.description: Load environment files from this project's dotenv/ directory into its target steps: dotenv/.env always (when enabled), then dotenv/.<env>.env when an environment is selected (--env, $SMITH_ENV, or repo.yml smith_env.default). Loaded values override repo-level dotenv files but sit below type and manifest environment entries.

working_dir.description: Where this project's target steps execute: its project directory or the repository root. Overrides the type's working_dir — exactly these two values, no arbitrary paths. Omit to inherit the type's setting (project when the type omits it).
